searchText: 4844 Call in ~25 minutes Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/795 Zoom: https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/88332629239?pwd=YmNpVVpaVy93RXhOTS9DYmNtWGtLdz09 did lighthouse devs weigh in on blob count since acd last week? It's a bit unclear from the EIP how wrapped transactions are actually encoded. It says "the blob transaction is wrapped to become `rlp([tx_payload, blobs, commitments, proofs])`" . Does it mean: A) RLP string inside the list, i.e. `rlp([tx_payload_rlp_string, blobs, commitments, proofs])` or B) list inside the list, i.e. `rlp([[chain_id, nonce, ..., r, s], blobs, commitments, proofs])` or C) flattened list, i.e. `rlp([chain_id, nonce, ..., r, s, blobs, commitments, proofs])` ? it's B) i think there is a PR to clarify more, but i didn't quite like how it was worded and meant to update i guess this is the PR in question 😆 https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/7123 Btw what is the plan for pruning blobs and how have clients implemented archiving them? Right now it isn't in the era format, so we would need to extend era? Tx hash is derived from transaction body, not from wrapped transaction, correct? Yes. And blob versioned hashes can be used to verify the wrapper, I guess Recording of today's call: https://youtu.be/jQ86ItkOfm0
